credits.subtitleGuest: Log in to purchase credits and redeem macro access.
credits.successMessage: Payment successful! Credits have been added. Please refresh the page to see your updated balance.
credits.cancelMessage: Payment cancelled. Please contact support if you have any issues.
credits.notice1: 1 CNY = 1 credit. Credits are added instantly after payment.
credits.notice2: Credits can only be used to redeem macro access and cannot be withdrawn or refunded.
credits.notice2Bold: only be used to redeem macro access and cannot be withdrawn or refunded
credits.notice3: Redeemed macros can be viewed unlimited times during their validity period. After expiration, you need to redeem again or renew.
credits.notice4: Regular macros are permanent after redemption. Premium macros default to a 30-day validity period with auto-renewal support.
credits.notice5: For payment issues, please contact support via the ticket system.

contact.metadataDescription: Having issues? Contact FlyMacro support via tickets, Telegram, or WeChat.
contact.ticketDesc: For account issues, payment problems, or macro usage questions, submitting a ticket is the fastest way to get a formal response. Our support team typically replies within 24 hours.
contact.telegramDesc: Suitable for English/Chinese communication, fast response.
contact.wechatDesc: Scan the QR code to add our support on WeChat.
contact.faq1: Credits not arriving after payment? Please confirm the payment is complete. Credits usually arrive within 1-5 minutes. If not received after 10 minutes, please submit a ticket with a payment screenshot.
contact.faq2: Macro code not showing? Please confirm you have redeemed the macro and it hasn't expired. Free macros don't require redemption.
contact.faq3: Auto-renewal failed? The system will attempt to deduct credits on the expiration date. If insufficient, auto-renewal stops and you'll be notified. You can manually renew after topping up credits.
contact.faq4: Credits are non-refundable. Please read the purchase notice before buying.
